corrections.proposed: R-6 flat cab (built 1957), replacing an L-4 cab from 1937
corrections.why: The L-4 cab dates from 1937. It was replaced in 1957 by an R-6 flat cab, which is the structure standing today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 1957 date is the current R-6 cab. The 1937 L-4 cab it replaced is the earlier structure.

notes_for_editor: Staffing: the register says semi-regularly staffed since 2001; firelookout.com says only that it was staffed in 2001. Access and rental not verified. Elevation: register 8,214 ft (2,504 m), firelookout.com 8284 ft; record 2503.6 m follows the register. The Powell County blog gives its newspaper quote as September 17, 1957 and then cites the same paper as September 17, 1954; the story says so. The Flathead NF Facebook lookout profile could not be read (page returned only its title), so it is not cited. A Forest Service Wikimedia Commons photo is geotagged about 60 m from the lookout, but the page does not say what the image shows, so no photo was added. Wikipedia says the 1957 lookout replaced a cabin of 1937, consistent with the register; it was used as a lead only.
